brief:
A senior Palestinian church affairs official has urged Christian leaders worldwide to intervene against escalating attacks, land confiscations, and restrictions targeting Palestinian Christians, the Palestine News Network reported. The official made the appeal from Ramallah in the West Bank, describing the situation as requiring concrete international response and mobilization from global Christian institutions.

The statement reflects mounting concerns within Palestinian Christian communities over their security and access to property. Christian minorities in the West Bank have faced various pressures amid the broader Israeli-Palestinian conflict, including limitations on movement and disputes over land ownership. The official's call signals that Palestinian church leaders view international advocacy as necessary to address what they characterize as systematic challenges to their communities' welfare and rights.

title: Palestinian church official calls for Christian leaders' action on attacks
